Name: Sleepless Fisherman
Author: Annosz
Description:
[size=5]Sleepless Fisherman[/size]

You are fishing for a Walleye to finish your Night Fisb Bundle. The water has been still for 10 minutes, and then suddenly, something changes. You pull your rod, but nothing is on it - theen you realize it was only a notification about you character's sleepyness at 1AM, even thought you are perfectly aware of the time.

Has this ever happened to you? If yes, and you find the sleep emote (the "ZZ" in a speech bubble above the farmer's head) too confusing during fishing, then this mod is for you. It does nothing else than disabling this annoying message if your character is fishing, thus preventing you to mix it with a catch notification.



[size=4]Requirements[/size]

This mod requires SMAPI.



﻿[size=4]Install[/size]
[list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io/]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into Stardew Valley/Mods.
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list][list=1][code][/code][/list]
